items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: go down on 12th Street and hear Pete Johnson play the blues

ctx.x: All of that. And then, not to speak of like when I first came to Kansas City, when I first came to Kansas City, I would go somewhere every night and listen because I would get off about 1:30 at night, and during that time, the joints was going until six, seven, eight, 9:00 in the morning, but the place I was working for, I got off at 1:30. So this give me a chance to make all the clubs, you know, and I used to come into clubs and I'd enjoy coming up and listening to Bus Moten's group, leave there and go hear…
steady rock and roll, steady beat. And Joe singing for 30 minutes. Well, I'd never seen anything like that in my life.
